scientific_integrity: The proof excludes odd prime divisors symbolically using an invertible fourth-order cube recurrence, Cassini identities and a four-residue calculation. Finite exact checks are supporting evidence, not an infinite certificate; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proven only for positive odd window lengths and standard Fibonacci and Lucas initial conditions; not a theorem for all generalized recurrences, higher powers, or even windows.
title: Odd-length cubic Fibonacci and Lucas window GCDs
